companies.name: TekGigz LLC
companies.discription: Worked on a finance-focused web application used by internal teams and small businesses to track transactions and generate real-time reports. The technology included Flask/Django for the backend, PostgreSQL as the relational DB, MongoDB/Redis for NoSQL support, and we deployed it using Docker and Jenkins on Heroku.

companies.name: Onshape Inc.
companies.discription: Built a custom data structure in Python to detect and trace system errors across modules, improving reliability and observability. I used MongoDB for error logs, Redis for real-time session data, and developed modular UI components in React and Angular with built-in validators and error indicators to highlight misconfigurations, streamlined development with Jenkins CI/CD.

companies.name: Adidas
companies.discription: Led a student team using Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace to manage timelines and communication. Organized virtual events via Zoom and Google Meet, and ran social media campaigns on Instagram and WhatsApp using Canva and Facebook Insights. Used basic data analysis to refine engagement strategies, aligning with Adidas’s digital outreach goals.
